info.title: AURA API
info.description:
AURA AI Health & Fitness Companion API.

### Authenticating in this page

Supabase Auth issues the token; this API only verifies it. To get one:

1. Sign in through the AURA frontend, or call Supabase directly:
   `POST https://<project>.supabase.co/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password`
   with the header `apikey: <anon key>` and body `{ "email": "...", "password": "..." }`.
2. Take `access_token` from the response — a JWT beginning `eyJ`.
3. Press **Authorize** above and paste it. No `Bearer ` prefix; Swagger adds it.
4. Optionally call `POST /api/auth/session` with the same token in the body. That is the bootstrap call: it verifies the token and creates the AURA user row on first contact. It is the one endpoint that takes the token in the **body** rather than the header, so it needs no Authorize.

A Supabase **Personal Access Token** (`sbp_...`), the **anon key**, and the **service role key** are all rejected — none of them is a user JWT, and only a user JWT carries the `sub` that identifies whose data is being read.

Nutrition figures returned by this API are estimates carrying a source and a confidence, and every one of them can be corrected by the user. They are not medical advice.

bearerAuth.description: A Supabase access token. Obtain one from Supabase Auth, then exchange it at `POST /api/auth/session` to provision the AURA user on first use.
